question: What physical arrangement enables mantra recitation upon the heads of two beings?
premises: The practitioner places both hands on the heads of those two.
The practitioner then mutters the mantra.
inference: Sitting and placing the hands on the heads of the two, one should mutter the mantra.
uncertainties: The identity of tayor is not specified in this verse alone
plain_english: Having sat down and placed both hands on their heads, one should mutter the mantra.
